_doc: Edit and re-render with scripts/animate.py. Times in seconds. 'stages' is the order; 'trans' is the length of each growth transition (one per gap, or one number for all); 'weights' scales individual gaps before the total is fitted to 'total' (set total to null to use trans as is). Camera keys: t is a fraction of the whole runtime, zoom 1.0 = whole sheet, cx/cy = frame centre as a fraction of the sheet.
